_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve surface_pde#5: OCCGeometry fed a shape that still carries a solid builds a VOLUME mesh, so ds runs over the volume boundary and a plain H1 lives on the ball. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, maxh=0.4 Curve(4) (2026-08-06): the solid gives mesh.dim=3 with ne=215 and Integrate(1*dx)=4.188798 (ball volume) and H1 order-2 ndof=506, whereas Glue(sphere.faces) gives ne=0, Integrate(1*dx)=0.0, Integrate(1*ds)=12.566386 and ndof=378, with grad(u)*grad(v)*dx assembling an EMPTY matrix while NGSolve prints 'used dof inconsistency'. Records two corrections to the claim text: selecting the faces does NOT make Mesh.dim return 2 (it stays 3; the discriminator is ne==0), and forcing dim=2 flattens the sphere into a planar 2-D mesh of area 6.066810 instead of 4*pi.
